# fora

> fora is an iOS app (coming soon to the App Store) that shows men how their dating
> profile actually lands. A panel of five verified women independently scores every
> photo and prompt on a signed -5 to +5 scale and picks a structured reason for each
> score. There is no matching, chatting, or swiping - fora is the mirror, not the
> dating app. Reviews contain no free text (score + preset reason only), and both
> sides pass a real-person selfie check. Anonymity runs one direction: reviewers see
> the submitted profile (name and age included) in order to review it, while the
> submitter never learns which reviewer gave which score. Reviewers score blind and
> cannot see each other's answers before submitting. 18+ only.
> Operated by Fora Holding LLC (Arizona, USA).

## Pages
